passive.name: Pix, Faerie Companion
passive.text: Pix fires magical bolts of energy whenever the champion he's following attacks another enemy unit. These bolts are homing, but can be intercepted by other units.

spells.name: Glitterlance
spells.text: Pix and Lulu each fire a bolt of magical energy that damages and heavily slows all enemies it hits.

spells.name: Whimsy
spells.text: If cast on an ally, grants them Attack Speed and Move Speed for a short time. If cast on an enemy, turns them into an adorable critter that can't attack or cast spells.

spells.name: Help, Pix!
spells.text: If cast on an ally, commands Pix to jump to an ally and shield them. He then follows them and aids their attacks. If cast on an enemy, commands Pix to jump to an enemy and damage them. He then follows them and grants you vision of that enemy.

spells.name: Wild Growth
spells.text: Lulu enlarges an ally, knocking nearby enemies into the air and granting the ally a large amount of bonus health. For the next few seconds, that ally gains an aura that slows nearby enemies.

damage.value: Lulu deals sustained magical damage through Pix’s attack-triggered bolts and burst magical damage with Glitterlance.

archetype.value: Lulu is an enchanter who shields and uses Whimsy to help allies stay safe.

axis.value: Lulu can poke at 925 range with Glitterlance and slow enemies it hits.

winCondition.value: Lulu wins by directing her vision and abilities toward the allies who are performing well.

spikes.why: Lulu’s abilities that enchant allies are amplified by this item.

spikes.at: When Help, Pix!’s cooldown falls from 10 to 8 seconds
spikes.why: Lulu can shield an ally or damage an enemy more often.

bait.why: After Lulu spends Whimsy, its 18-second cooldown leaves her unable to use it to disable an enemy.
